# SheetJS dependency

This directory contains the browser build of SheetJS Community Edition v0.18.5.

- Upstream: https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs/tree/v0.18.5
- Source file: `dist/xlsx.full.min.js`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE.txt`)

The app ships this file locally so the service worker can cache the spreadsheet parser and support offline use.
